changelog: React Bits BranchedMenu Component: Native Jetpack Compose implementation of reactbits.dev BranchedMenu with collapsible tree sections, dynamic bezier branch curves, and zero-allocation draw phase rendering
Animated Laser Reach Path: Dynamic PathMeasure vector stroke tracing along curved branch lines directly to the chosen active item with cubic-bezier ease-out timing
Gliding Trunk Marker: Smooth luminous indicator sliding vertically along the outer trunk backbone to lock onto the active section header
Interactive Drawer Integration: New Branched Menu quick-navigation accessible directly from the drawer header with Gravent Hub navigation and React Bits demo modes
